posts.name: PixVerse R2
posts.tagline: A real-time world model you can explore and change
posts.description: PixVerse R2 is a real-time world model that generates continuously evolving audiovisual worlds instead of fixed video clips. It accepts text, images, audio and actions while generating, remembers what happened earlier in the session, and carries those changes forward in real time. R2 scales to longer, more coherent and controllable experiences — powering everything from interactive stories and characters to playable generative worlds.

posts.name: Bleetz Network
posts.tagline: AI agent-to-agent VC fundraising & scouting network
posts.description: Fundraising is broken. Founders spend weeks searching for VCs, researching investment theses, checking sectors, stages and geographies, and sending cold emails, often without knowing who is actually a good fit. Bleetz Network automates the first part of this process. Your AI agent gets matched with 2,000+ SIMULATED agents of real VC, pitches the funds that fit your startup, and gets a YES, NO or MAYBE. A YES unlocks the fund’s contact details. Free, no strings attached.

posts.name: Quiver GTM
posts.tagline: Run developer marketing like an engineering system
posts.description: Quiver is an agentic developer marketing system for technical founders and dev-tool teams. It keeps product context, customer evidence, campaigns, content, tasks and results connected in one controlled system. Unlike another AI writing tool, Quiver gives agents durable context, version history, explicit production states, a Content API, MCP access and a human-approved feedback loop. Use hosted Quiver with managed team access and built-in tasks, or self-host the free MIT-licensed edition.

posts.name: 10xJoy
posts.tagline: Discover desired outcomes + connect w/ builders who can help
posts.description: Meet Joy, your free AI business matchmaker. Turn business goals into an editable brief without knowing what to build. Our early beta is welcoming its first builders. You choose what to share; introductions are coordinated by email. Builder work is scoped and priced directly.

posts.name: DEV·TV
posts.tagline: A retro TV for GitHub, HN, Hugging Face & more: 10 channels
posts.description: Most devs check GitHub, Hacker News, DEV and Hugging Face out of habit. DEV·TV turns them into 10 live channels that play on their own, like TV. Glance, catch one story, get back to coding. Leave it on an office screen or a remote team's always-on tab and it becomes shared context: everyone sees what's rising, and anyone can point and ask "did you see this?" One HTML file: no backend, no login, no build step. Real source data, built-in reader, no AI summaries. Free and MIT-licensed.

posts.name: Designeer
posts.tagline: Bringing the best of the internet together
posts.description: Explore the Best of the Internet for Builders Designeer is a curated platform bringing the best of the internet together for designers, developers, and builders. Discover design inspiration, component libraries, design systems, AI tools, coding agents, MCP servers, and creators worth learning from, all in one place. Discover. Learn. Build. Showcase.

posts.name: Wand
posts.tagline: Build software at the speed of thought
posts.description: For builders who think faster than they type. The keyboard is becoming the bottleneck. Wand lets you think out loud instead of stopping to translate ideas into prompts. Ramble, react, change your mind mid-sentence - Wand keeps up and turns your thoughts into software. Welcome to the post-keyboard era.

posts.name: Howseen AI
posts.tagline: Track how AI recommends your brand, and get cited
posts.description: Your buyers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity which tool or brand to buy. Howseen tracks whether AI recommends you or your competitors across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, finds the exact questions where you're invisible, and generates SEO & GEO-optimized content to get you cited, auto-published to your blog on the highest-impact gaps first. Most tools stop at a score. Howseen closes the loop: measure, then act. Free to see where you stand today.

posts.name: Promptic
posts.tagline: Optimize GenAI applications for quality and cost
posts.description: Promptic is the optimization platform for GenAI applications, better quality at lower cost. Benchmark models, tune prompts and agents, and optimize tool use against your own data and business metrics. Every candidate is scored on the quality and cost you actually care about, so you ship the configuration that wins instead of the one that sounded right. Runs wherever you are, dashboard UI, your CI, or your coding agent.

posts.name: ShroomPen
posts.tagline: Reply, rewrite, fix grammar, translate with single extension
posts.description: ShroomPen is a privacy-first browser writing assistant that lets you instantly reply, rewrite, fix grammar, or translate text across any website without sending sensitive data to the cloud. Designed to balance AI convenience with absolute data privacy, it keeps all your page, field, tab, and session context securely on your device, giving you complete control over your everyday web workflow.

posts.name: Jango
posts.tagline: Test multi-user apps with AI agents that act like real users
posts.description: Jango lets you test the parts of your app that need more than one person. It gives your app a group of AI users, each with its own browser, account, goals and memory. Point Jango at your dev URL and watch them sign in and interact with each other in real time. Direct them, join in as yourself, or take control of any user's screen. At the end you get a report with actions, errors and screenshots. Use your own AI key or Jango's managed AI. Available on Mac.

posts.name: Donna
posts.tagline: Schedule multiple meetings with one link
posts.description: Donna lets you combine a sequence of meetings into a single booking link. Instead of sending different links for every call, one link chains all meetings together with conditions like setting time gaps between meetings or keeping the next meeting locked until the previous one is completed. It also includes built-in workflows to prioritize important meetings, fill cancellations, route meetings across teams, and more.

posts.name: SocialGPT
posts.tagline: Edit videos by chatting with your timeline
posts.description: Upload your footage and tell SocialGPT what to change. Tighten the cut, add captions, bring in B-roll, music, and sound effects. Keep refining through chat or edit the timeline yourself. For creators and business owners who want to make videos without learning every editing tool.

posts.name: Basedash MCP write
posts.tagline: Build charts and dashboards from Cursor and Claude
posts.description: Basedash MCP can now write, not just read. From Cursor, Claude, or any MCP client, ask for a chart or a whole dashboard—Basedash explores the schema, writes and validates the SQL, picks the visualization, and lays it out. The result comes back as a real Basedash chart with a durable link and a rendered image, so you can keep iterating in the IDE or share it with the team. Edit it the same way: “break it out by plan” updates the live chart. Not just read. Write.

posts.name: Squints
posts.tagline: Design tools for the live web
posts.description: Squints puts design tools on top of any live web page. Measure spacing, drag out guides, overlay a column grid, pick colours in any format, see the font that actually rendered, and slow down or scrub any animation. Free, no account, no tracking.

posts.name: Kaiku
posts.tagline: The task tracker your AI agents already know how to use
posts.description: A task tracker and wiki built for teams whose work is increasingly done by AI agents. It speaks the API of the tracker most companies already run, so the MCP servers your agents use work unchanged. Built-in MCP server for Claude Code and Cursor, agents you call in a comment that propose but never decide, and every agent run's cost recorded on the issue it worked on.

posts.name: Fit Receipt
posts.tagline: A private fitting agent that knows when to call JEV
posts.description: Try on lingerie virtually; every pick has an AI judgment receipt. Fit Receipt is a reference implementation. The agent handles chat; code protects facts and pricing. JEV (TypeSafe) is a judgment model that scores trade-offs with calibrated confidence in ~300ms—not essays. Low-confidence results stay unresolved; judgments are recorded; works without JEV. Photos stay in your browser; no server photo storage. JEV sees typed fields, never the photo. Rate-limited API. Vercel + open source.

posts.name: Once UI 2.0
posts.tagline: Builds consistent React apps for developers and AI agents
posts.description: Once UI is an open-source design system for building polished React products with less repetitive code. Compose layouts with readable primitives, use a shared system of components and design tokens, and keep the result consistent as your product grows. Version 2.0 gives both you and your coding agent a clearer way to work. Its component catalog, compact rules, and task guides help agents use the system correctly; its foundations and predictable APIs make the output easier for you to understand.

posts.name: Kapshot
posts.tagline: Screen recordings that look like you edited them
posts.description: Kapshot is a screen recorder for people who need polished product demos, tutorials, and videos, without spending time editing them. Instead of recording your screen and then opening a video editor to add zooms, fix the cursor, and frame every interaction, Kapshot does the polish automatically while you record.

posts.name: FRCTL
posts.tagline: Mind-Bending Media and Live Visuals
posts.description: FRCTL is one engine for everything an artist ships and runs in the browser. Import your own footage or create generative shader scenes. Build a look, then pull cover art, a Spotify Canvas or a social clip. Run the loop live with direct full screen output. 190+ effects with infinite modulation and route audio into any parameter. Camera and canvas capture in live mode. Sell your presets or loops right in the Collective or post and comment on the member feed. Create, perform, monetize, collab.

posts.name: Kairn
posts.tagline: Turn any recorded convo into actionables and follow ups
posts.description: Kairn turns conversations into the people, promises and next steps worth remembering. Capture a meeting—with everyone’s consent—or a quick thought. Review the people, tasks and dates Kairn finds, edit every detail, then save approved contacts, reminders and calendar events to your iPhone. Helpful AI, human control. Install the public TestFlight beta.

posts.name: Meta VR Glasses
posts.tagline: A Cinema, Courtside Seat, and Workspace in Just 100 Grams
posts.description: Meta VR Glasses bring full virtual reality into a glasses-like 100g design. Get a 5K micro-OLED display, Dolby Vision and Atmos, eye and hand tracking, Meta AI, the Quest app library, immersive movies and live sports, gaming, and a private multi-screen workspace — without strapping a heavy computer to your face. The glasses connect to a pocketable compute puck and launch in Spring 2027 for $1,299.99.

posts.name: WebDecoy for Vercel
posts.tagline: Know which crawlers hit your Vercel app, and which are fake
posts.description: Connect a project and WebDecoy reads your Vercel log drain. No code changes. It identifies crawler traffic per request, verifies real crawlers against published IP ranges, and flags forged user agents. Monitoring only: it never blocks, never reports humans.

posts.name: Pair2FA
posts.tagline: Secure 2FA sharing for teams
posts.description: Pair2FA makes it easier for teams to share access to accounts protected by 2FA. No more asking someone for a code, sharing screenshots, or waiting for the person with the authenticator to be available. With Pair2FA, teammates can access the 2FA code when they need it, without interrupting whoever manages the account. It keeps shared accounts protected while making everyday team access much simpler.

posts.name: WapiSender
posts.tagline: Powerful WhatsApp automations with AI, visual flows and MCP
posts.description: Build WhatsApp automations with AI agents, visual workflows, MCP tools, APIs and webhooks. Automate customer conversations, campaigns and business processes with WapiSender.

posts.name: AgreeGuard
posts.tagline: AI reads the fine print before you click "I Agree"
posts.description: 91% of people accept terms and conditions without reading them. AgreeGuard is a free Chrome extension that reads the fine print for you. One click, and in under 15 seconds you get a plain-English summary with red flags highlighted auto-renewals, data selling, hidden fees, waived legal rights, and privacy concerns. Works on any website. No account needed.

posts.name: DokBot
posts.tagline: Turn your docs into a support chatbot for your website
posts.description: DokBot builds an AI chatbot from your PDFs and text files. It answers questions 24/7 and gets the users email what it can't solve — it never makes up an answer.

posts.name: Kelam
posts.tagline: Let your agent make the calls you don't want to
posts.description: Your assistant can reach anything with a URL. The locksmith, the clinic and the garage don't have one. Kelam gives an AI assistant a phone number of its own — one it dials out from, and one that answers when it rings. One sentence installs it in Claude, Muse, a coding agent or your terminal.

posts.name: HireOtto
posts.tagline: Run your performance marketing stack from AI
posts.description: HireOtto connects Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and Search Console to the AI client you already use. Investigate performance across platforms, then make supported changes in Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads from the same conversation. Hosted MCP servers handle authentication and APIs, with no local setup. Google Analytics is in beta.

posts.name: OmniNotch
posts.tagline: The notch that does it all!
posts.description: OmniNotch turns your MacBook notch into a real workspace. Twenty tools in one hover: Ask Omni (on-device Apple Intelligence), now playing, clipboard, file shelf & AirDrop, teleprompter, timers, weather, stocks, live AI usage, and more. Native. Private. No account. No cloud. No telemetry. Lifetime license - $14.99, up to 3 Macs.

posts.name: InfraGrid3D
posts.tagline: Full Civil Engineering design in the Web Browser LOD 400+
posts.description: Design roads, underground utilities and public lighting in your browser. Live long sections, clash detection IFC, CAD and native Revit export — no install.

posts.name: Tellwe
posts.tagline: Your coffee cup tells its story.
posts.description: Upload a Turkish coffee cup. Tellwe finds the symbols in the grounds, writes a personal 45-second reading, and brings it to life through a character you can share. The name comes from “telve” the Turkish word for the coffee grounds left in the cup, where the fortune is traditionally read — reimagined as Tellwe: a cup with a story to tell.

posts.name: Token Forecaster
posts.tagline: Forecast how long an LLM reply will run, before Enter
posts.description: Token Forecaster puts a range on an LLM reply before you press Enter: the usual length, and a worst case that held for 90.6% of 4,146 unseen calls. While the reply streams, it shows whether it is running long. It only watches and never changes the request. Learns from your local history. Open source, MIT.

posts.name: Hyperdream
posts.tagline: The Cursor of AI filmmaking
posts.description: AI filmmaking is fragmented across scripts, characters, visuals, video models, and editing tools. Hyperdream brings the entire workflow into one intelligent AI filmmaking platform. Create from idea to final video while Hyperdream manages context, recommends the right models, maintains consistency, and handles the heavy lifting so creators can focus on storytelling not juggling tools.

posts.name: Aks.ai
posts.tagline: Your personal companion for guided self-reflection.
posts.description: Aks is a personal companion that helps you talk through what's happening in your life, reflect on your thoughts, and understand yourself better. We built Aks to be a private, judgment-free space for daily guided reflection. Unpack your day, process your feelings, and gain valuable insights into your own mind. Whether you're navigating stress, celebrating wins, or just need to vent, Aks is always here to listen and help you grow.

posts.name: Fivemetrics
posts.tagline: Understand cloud and AI spend, then investigate what changed
posts.description: Bring supported cloud and AI billing sources into one cost workspace. Explore available breakdowns, review budgets and anomalies, and assign costs to teams. Start with a concrete question, then follow the evidence behind the bill.

posts.name: Kliva
posts.tagline: Trail race plans that sync to your Garmin
posts.description: Kliva turns any of 31,000+ trail and ultra races into a race-day plan: pacing per segment on the real terrain, fueling with the actual gels and drink mixes you carry, caffeine and sodium dosed to your body, and a cutoff margin at every aid station. Then it syncs the plan to your Garmin as a free Connect IQ data field: aid stations, cutoffs and fuel reminders on your wrist, updated over the air. Plus a printable roadbook, a crew sheet link, FIT and CSV export. Free, in five languages.

posts.name: DemoScreen
posts.tagline: Turn product screenshots into a narrated demo video
posts.description: DemoScreen turns screenshots of your product into a finished demo video. Upload your screenshots, and it writes the script, adds a voiceover, background music and captions. Choose from five templates and three formats: 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1. Narration is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese and French. Each video comes with an MP4 file, SRT captions, a GIF and a share link. A free plan is available.

posts.name: Markly
posts.tagline: A calm, native Markdown editor for your folders
posts.description: Markly is a free, open-source Markdown editor for macOS that edits themd files in folders you already have: no import, no database, no lock-in. Formatting renders as you type, and markers hide on lines you're not editing. Native SwiftUI + AppKit with Liquid Glass, no Electron. Format bar on selection, clickable tasks, one-click Git sync, focus mode, scroll-synced preview with math, HTML/PDF export. No accounts, no tracking.

posts.name: layernote
posts.tagline: Visual feedback on websites, Figma files, PDFs and images
posts.description: Collect visual feedback on live websites, PDFs and images. Clients pin comments through a share link, no account needed. Keep discussions and tasks in one place, and work through changes yourself or with your team. For website fixes, you can also hand feedback to your coding agent via MCP.

posts.name: Perfect Slice
posts.tagline: You have one cut to get a perfect slice
posts.description: A minimalist precision-cutting game. Draw one straight cut to slice off exactly the requested percentage of an irregular shape. Free to play, no download.

posts.name: Forkest
posts.tagline: Turn your GitHub contributions into a pixel-art garden
posts.description: Forkest turns your GitHub contribution calendar into a pixel-art garden. Each day is a plot: no commits leaves bare soil, 8+ puts it in bloom. The garden changes with the seasons, from spring flowers to winter snow. Connect GitHub and it grows as you code.

posts.name: Stimly
posts.tagline: Real-time caffeine metabolism curve and bedtime estimate
posts.description: Stimly models estimated caffeine levels over time. Inputs: drink logs, body profile, and a short calibration quiz. The system renders a live clearance curve, distinguishes slow sipping from fast intake, tracks tolerance trends, and shows estimated caffeine remaining at bedtime.

posts.name: Cutsio
posts.tagline: One video asset library shared with your whole team
posts.description: Still fiddling with large video files across Hard drives, Google drive links and dropbox folders? Cutsio is an AI native Video Media Asset Management Software that creates a single, shareable video library that your whole team can access with AI auto tagging, AI Summaries, Visual Intelligence, Intelligent content repurposing edits and handing off importable EDL & XML for Final Cut Pro and DaVinci Resolve so that you still retain the human taste in your final edits

posts.name: shadow-planner
posts.tagline: AI-assisted gantt project planning that runs on your machine
posts.description: Desktop project planner for Windows, macOS and Linux. Gantt with dependencies, resource utilisation, what-if scenarios, and an AI assistant that knows your plan. Runs on a local Ollama model by default. No account, no cloud, no subscription — €4.99 once.

posts.name: Pinky Promise
posts.tagline: A reminder for the promises you make with friends
posts.description: I turned Pinky Promise into a tiny digital contract. Pick something you want to do, make a promise, decorate it, and add a ridiculous penalty if someone bails. It’s intentionally silly, but the commitment is real. A playful alternative to another calendar reminder, designed to turn “we should do that sometime” into “okay, we’re actually doing it.”

posts.name: FinalFrame
posts.tagline: AI photo critique: what to fix next and when to stop editing
posts.description: Other critique tools grade a photo once. FinalFrame scores your edit against the original and tells you when to stop. Upload a photo and in about a minute you get one named problem and the slider values to fix it in Lightroom or Capture One. Upload your next version and see what changed and what is still holding it back. Free plan, 12 languages. Launch month: your first paid month comes with 50% extra credits.

posts.name: Dictoterix
posts.tagline: Language learning service built around the dichotic method
posts.description: Dictoterix is the first online learning service built end-to-end around the bilingual-dichotic method: your native language in one ear, the language you're learning in the other, at the same moment. Most apps teach “words”. The question that matters is which words — so every level in Dictoterix is measured against a reference inventory of what an A1–C1 learner actually needs. No card. No trial clock. It's just free.

posts.name: LaterOn v2: The agentic email plaftform
posts.tagline: Describe an email job once. Get sh*t done.
posts.description: Please welcome LaterOn v2: a comprehensive email platform now capable of sending and receiving all types of emails. The platform comes with the agentic email workflows; simply describe an email task once, and the agent handles the execution—from monitoring relevant emails and replying with appropriate context to following up on non-responses and closing the conversation thread once your goal is achieved.

posts.name: RemoteConsole
posts.tagline: Reach your home or work terminal when agents can't or won't
posts.description: RemoteConsole is a mobile SSH terminal built for developer on the go. Especially for running AI coding agents from your phone. Connect to your own Mac and Linux machines and reattach to the persistent tmux session where Claude Code, Codex, Aider or Gemini CLI is working. Steer it by touch or voice. When the agent stalls or refuses, or the task shouldn't be delegated, you have a real shell right there. You can reach machines behind NAT with no VPN, and an SFTP browser comes built in.

posts.name: Memoire
posts.tagline: Where thoughts become manuscripts without friction.
posts.description: A local-first, distraction-free writing app. Keyboard-driven, private by default, and fast enough to keep up with your thoughts.

posts.name: Evvery
posts.tagline: Everyday AI meant for everyone.
posts.description: Evvery is the personal AI we were all promised. Built for professionals, parents, students and anyone who could benefit from organized and helpful AI. Evvery makes it so you never have to re-explain yourself. Organizing your chats into Spaces, for each part of your life, instead of a pile of unorganized chats. Home, Kids, Work, Study, whatever matters to you. Private, and yours alone. Never trained on your data. See and control everything Evvery knows about you. Free or upgrade for $10 a month.

posts.name: JevForAgents
posts.tagline: Explore real Jev agent builds, demos, and patterns
posts.description: Explore 360+ curated Jev AI agent builds, open-source code & video demos. Discover Claude Code skills, browser agents & SEO workflows with latenJev for Agents helps developers explore how Jev is used in AI agent workflows. Browse source-linked builds, video demos, repositories, and implementation patterns for browser automation, routing, tool selection, evaluation, and guardrails. Follow an example to its source, then use the guides to try a pattern in your own agent.

posts.name: UIDCaption
posts.tagline: Automatic and animated captions, completely offline
posts.description: UIDCaption is a Windows app for creating automatic and animated captions without uploading your videos to the cloud. Everything runs locally on your PC, with a visual editor that gives you full control over your captions. Just import your video, generate the captions, edit them and export.

posts.name: Polyglot
posts.tagline: Create and translate subtitles entirely on your Mac
posts.description: Turn recordings into subtitles, translate SRT/VTT files, and export readable transcripts on your Mac. Polyglot keeps media and AI processing local, with editing, bilingual exports, batch translation, video enhancement and compression in one native app. Try unlimited transcription and translation for 7 days without an account. Pro is €29.99 once; editing, conversion, exports and video tools stay free. For Apple Silicon, macOS 14.4+.

posts.name: COOLDOWN
posts.tagline: A little pause before your next impulse purchase
posts.description: Save what catches your eye, give it time, then decide. COOLDOWN turns shopping links into a personal cooling-off list, with editable product details, countdowns, widgets and optional reminders. Take a Second Look at your original reason before buying or letting go. Plus adds activity trials, purpose comparisons, temptation memory, Worth Keeping and Unbought Receipts. For iPhone. Your first five items are free; Plus offers unlimited new items.

posts.name: MIDIpad
posts.tagline: Your gamepad is a musical instrument
posts.description: MIDIpad is a macOS application that transforms game controllers into musical instruments compatible with any modern digital audio workstation. More than simply mapping gamepad buttons to MIDI notes or CCs, MIDIpad turns your gamepad into two powerful, accessible, MPE-capable MIDI controllers: Chords, an expressive, scale-aware plucked-string engine, and Drums, a real-time, gesture-driven drum sequencer.

posts.name: TourKit
posts.tagline: Lightweight product tours with a hosted dashboard
posts.description: TourKit is a lightweight product tour tool for any website. Most tools are either heavy & expensive (Appcues, Pendo) or pure code libraries with no dashboard (Shepherd, Intro.js). TourKit sits in the middle: → One script tag (React, Next.js, Vue, WordPress, HTML) → Hosted dashboard — edit tours without redeploying → Context-aware steps (works with dynamic URLs) → Clean dark-glass tooltips + basic analytics Pricing: Free · $9 · $19 Note: Paid plans are in demo mode. Free tier is fully working.

posts.name: 14 gentle mornings by Small WIns
posts.tagline: Audio first physiotherapy delivered via WhatsApp
posts.description: Small Wins is a 14-day audio movement programme delivered to WhatsApp every morning. No app, no login, no equipment, no floor work. Each day: a 30-second personal intro from your coach, a 7-minute guided session (movement, breathing, a food swap), then a quick check-in that shapes tomorrow. Designed by a physiotherapist, enhanced by AI, built for women 55+ who want to feel stronger without the gym.

posts.name: GitHub statistics · Velocity Radar
posts.tagline: Real GitHub momentum, including private repos & AI agents
posts.description: Standard GitHub profiles only count green squares. Velocity Radar measures true momentum across public and private repos without exposing private code. Features: • Pace: Compares your last 30 active days to your historical baseline. • Breakdown: Sorts commits into substantive, automated, and merges. • Stamina: Tracks unbroken runs and multi-day solid streaks. Built for high-output developers and AI agent commanders. Add a dynamic radar to your profile.

posts.name: CrbonFree
posts.tagline: Audit-grade carbon numbers for every AI token you use
posts.description: How much energy and carbon does your AI use? CrbonFree meters every call, per model and per provider, and turns the answer into a report an auditor can check.

posts.name: FLYBOX
posts.tagline: Explore a fruit-fly connectome inside a living sandbox
posts.description: FlyBox is an open-source interactive sandbox built around a simulated fruit-fly connectome with 166,700 neurons and ~25.6M synapses. Give the fly food, predators, obstacles, light and other stimuli, then watch its neural activity and behavior change in real time. Stimulate or silence neural populations, lesion connections, fork experiments, compare brains and inspect what the fly is doing as it happens.

posts.name: Relium
posts.tagline: Catch risky dbt changes before they break business metrics
posts.description: Relium is a pre-merge reliability layer for SQL and dbt. It reviews every PR, understands semantic changes, traces downstream model and KPI impact, checks warehouse evidence, and returns ALLOW / WARN / BLOCK before production. Unlike observability tools that alert after data breaks, Relium helps teams catch silent logic failures before they ship.

posts.name: Split
posts.tagline: Resize connected Mac windows together, with live content
posts.description: Split is a macOS menu-bar window manager. Arrange windows, then drag their shared divider to resize both while their contents update live. Click the divider to swap sides. Click a side's window count to open its switcher; click again to cycle through stacked windows. Works with left-right and top-bottom layouts. $4.99 once for one active Mac. macOS 13+, Apple silicon and Intel.

posts.name: NexusAXI
posts.tagline: Research, plan, create, and automate recurring work
posts.description: NexusAXI is an AI platform built for founders who need more than answers. It combines advanced reasoning, image generation, persistent memory, workflow automation, and autonomous scheduled bots in one system. Use Nexus to research, plan, create, automate recurring work, and keep supported tasks moving after the chat ends — with one login, one memory, and one AI running your workflow.

posts.name: Decktly
posts.tagline: Edit HTML presentations like PowerPoint
posts.description: Decktly is an HTML editor that works like PowerPoint. Open an AI-generated deck, edit text and layouts, add charts and tables, and leave comments. Save your work as HTML. Available on Windows, Mac, and in your browser.

posts.name: World Signal
posts.tagline: See where the world is behaving abnormally.
posts.description: WORLD SIGNAL monitors real-world systems: earthquakes, wildfires, internet connectivity, aviation and more, to detect unusual activity across the planet. Explore anomalies, compare them with historical baselines, and investigate the evidence behind every signal.

posts.name: Trylle
posts.tagline: The AI-powered Git platform for modern software teams
posts.description: Trylle is an AI-powered Git platform for the future of software development, where agents and humans ship together. Alongside full GitHub parity (Actions CI, PRs, Issues), we offer AI-native features: automated PR reviews, security audits, and customizable repo automations with the model and harness of your choice. Our latest product, Magic Sessions, runs long-horizon tasks across multiple repos in a VM with Ubuntu or macOS. Powered by Vercel AI Gateway and Vercel Sandboxes across 18 regions.

posts.name: Pause
posts.tagline: Pause. Before you scroll.
posts.description: Pause is a screen-time iPhone app that stops mindless scrolling before it starts. Solve a quick puzzle to unlock Instagram, TikTok, or any app — and give yourself a real moment to choose.

posts.name: Superdock
posts.tagline: simple, better faster dock for mac
posts.description: A free Mac Dock alternative that gives every Chrome profile its own icon. Some extras like Window previews, Alt-Tab switcher and a dock on every display, one mouse click shortcut to mission control and stage manager Free to download

posts.name: minimo (video)
posts.tagline: Compress videos. Not your privacy.
posts.description: A free, open-source video compressor for iOS and Android. Shrink videos directly on your device — no uploads, no accounts, no subscriptions. Your videos shouldn't need to leave your phone just to become smaller. minimo is a free, open-source video compressor for iOS and Android that processes everything directly on your device. No uploading a private video to a server. No waiting for it to download again. No account. No subscription.

posts.name: Report Card - Doomscroll District School
posts.tagline: Report cards for your posts by one tired teacher.
posts.description: Report Card is the official grade slip of Doomscroll District School, Fall 2026 semester. Accredited by nobody. (We checked.) Enrollment takes one social media handle to grade card. No login, no password, nothing to install. Private accounts are politely turned away at the gate. The teacher reads your recent public posts and grades six subjects. Grades run from A+ (with a gold star sticker) to F (Parents meeting).

posts.name: MIND GAME · RRR PRO MEX
posts.tagline: An AI-assisted brain game with endless logic challenges
posts.description: MIND GAME is a browser-based brain challenge from RRR PRO MEX. Solve math, logic, pattern, memory, color and knowledge challenges across progressive levels. Early levels use built-in challenges, while later levels can be generated and validated through AI. Earn rewards, unlock power items, manage your bag and build a daily streak. Free to play, no installation required.

posts.name: Cover Culture
posts.tagline: Don't judge a book. Buy its cover.
posts.description: Why does a book only get one cover? Cover Culture gives books the freedom they deserve. Through print-on-demand technology, artists create and earn royalties on custom editions of books they love, and readers get to own a cover that truly speaks to them. Lets build a cover culture.

posts.name: BuildBase App
posts.tagline: The whole SaaS backend, not just auth - one React SDK
posts.description: Every SaaS rebuilds the same backend plumbing, or stitches together single-purpose tools: auth (Clerk/Kinde), a database, billing. BuildBase gives you the whole backend in one React/Next.js SDK: auth, billing, multi-tenancy, RBAC, workflows, notifications, feature flags, analytics, and more. What's different: bring your own Stripe at a 0% platform fee, and self-host on your own infra and DB - no lock-in. I run five live products on BuildBase myself, not a demo. npm install and ship.

posts.name: Second Reality (1993) in your browser
posts.tagline: Future Crew's 1993 demo, ported from source. No emulator.
posts.description: Future Crew's Second Reality, the Assembly '93 demo, ported from the original C, x86 assembly and Pascal to JavaScript. No DOS, no emulator: the original software rasterisers, VGA palette tricks and copy-protected S3M music, live in a browser. Public domain.

posts.name: SubPorter
posts.tagline: Safe Stripe subscription handoffs for SaaS acquisitions
posts.description: SubPorter moves the Stripe Billing side of a SaaS handoff. Recreate products, prices, and meters, verify copied customers, and anchor destination schedules to real renewal dates before source cancellation. Prevents double billing with three safety gates.

posts.name: Snow Day Calculator
posts.tagline: Check your real snow day chance in one tap
posts.description: Free snow day calculator for 2026-27 for the USA and Canada. Enter your ZIP or postal code to see your school closure chance from live hour by hour forecasts, black ice checks and regional school habits.

posts.name: ORIVEN
posts.tagline: Put your entire advertising workflow in ORDER
posts.description: OrivenAI brings the advertising workflow into one connected AI system. Research your market, create ad creatives, launch campaigns, manage performance, automate optimization and keep your business context connected throughout. Instead of stitching together separate tools for every step, OrivenAI puts advertising in ORDER.

posts.name: Docora
posts.tagline: Open source React & Next.js docs framework with MCP server
posts.description: Docora is an open source documentation framework for Next.js and React. Write MDX, get routing, search, SEO, dark mode and i18n for free. It also ships an MCP server, llms.txt and an in-page assistant, so AI tools can read your docs as well as people can.

posts.name: ImgKit
posts.tagline: 50 Image Tools, Right in Your Browser
posts.description: I built ImgKit because I was tired of searching for a different website every time I needed to compress, resize, convert, or edit an image. ImgKit brings 50+ everyday image tools into one place, with processing happening directly in your browser. No uploads, no signup, and many tools work offline.

posts.name: Cohezly
posts.tagline: Product-ready design system for AI products
posts.description: Cohezly is a free Figma design system for building AI products. It includes thoughtfully designed primitives, components, patterns, and examples for creating consistent high quality AI experiences. Use it directly in Figma, or connect it to your coding agent through Figma MCP.

posts.name: Tween UI
posts.tagline: Free animated React components you own and modify
posts.description: A free collection of animated React components and blocks, built with GSAP and Tailwind CSS. The shadcn registry command copies the full code into your project. Own the code and modify it to suit your taste. Free and open source (MIT).

posts.name: Leagology
posts.tagline: Put a tournament on. Build a scene.
posts.description: Not one night — something that keeps going. We give you the tools to make it feel like a proper production: the draw on the big screen, scores as they land, and a rating that follows every player. That's how a room turns into a community. Pool, darts and rackets, for pubs, clubs and any room where people compete.

posts.name: Founder Battle
posts.tagline: Turn product activity into ongoing distribution
posts.description: Founder Battle helps products get seen through ongoing activity, not a one-time listing. Join the global ladder, challenge the product above you, judge matchups, share results, and get challenged by other founders. Each action brings products back into view, creating new chances for discovery and feedback. Challenges are free, independent Arena Votes decide rank, and paid exposure never buys votes, wins, or position.

posts.name: Predict-With-Jev
posts.tagline: AI
posts.description: JEV Terminal is a crypto research workspace powered by TypeSafe JEV. Explore live Kraken markets, compare assets with AI, inspect forecasts, and track their outcomes over time. Test BUY/HOLD/SELL strategies in an autonomous paper account with clear costs and limits. Connect MetaMask or Rabby to review ETH/USDC swaps on Base and approve every real transaction yourself. Built for traders who want to understand the evidence, test new ideas, and make informed decisions while staying in full control.

posts.name: GotMyBadge
posts.tagline: Branded event badges your attendees can make and share
posts.description: Give every attendee an 'I'm attending' badge worth posting. Brand it in minutes; attendees add a photo and share a PNG, GIF or MP4. Photos never leave their device.

posts.name: Sunday By Valkence - Global Activities
posts.tagline: Something Happens Every Sunday
posts.description: Something Happens Every Sunday

posts.name: WalkFarm
posts.tagline: Turn your daily steps into farm energy
posts.description: Walk to play. WalkFarm is a relaxed pixel farming game where the steps you already take become energy for your homestead. Clear land, plant seeds, water crops, and harvest them as they grow over a few days. Your steps are counted in the background, and every 100 steps becomes 1 farm energy. Play with friends, earn gifts on 10,000 step days, and unlock new seeds in the gem shop. Your step data stays on your device. It is never sold or used for ads.

posts.name: Verbier
posts.tagline: Background removal API with 50 free images a month.
posts.description: Verbier is a background removal API. Send a photo and the subject comes back on a transparent background in about two seconds, with hair, fur and white-on-white products intact. Every account gets 50 free images a month, and paid plans start at $9 for 1,000.

posts.name: DidWork
posts.tagline: Verify agent outcomes, not just tool calls.
posts.description: AI agents often report success because a tool call completed, even when the actual outcome is wrong or incomplete. DidWork independently verifies agent work against the expected result, gives agents clear pass/fail gates, and can trigger repair when verification fails. It works through MCP and an SDK, supports multiple providers, and produces shareable verification receipts so developers can see what was checked and whether the work was actually done.

posts.name: Confidash
posts.tagline: AI mock interviews based on your actual resume
posts.description: AI interview practice for campus placements. Sarah reads your resume, asks HR and technical questions, pushes back, and scores every answer. 15 min free.

posts.name: problems.live
posts.tagline: The internet's open list of problems worth solving
posts.description: A public directory of real problems. Post a problem, see how many others have it with "I have this too," discuss it, and propose solutions. No feature requests in disguise, just real friction, validated by demand, out in the open.

posts.name: AuditSpark
posts.tagline: AI website health audits, SEO analysis & automated fixes.
posts.description: Test your website before Most website scanners just give you a list of errors. AuditSpark finds technical SEO, performance, and accessibility issues, explains why they matter, and uses AI to generate developer-ready fixes or direct GitHub pull requests. Find it, fix it, verify it.your customers do. ScanFix automatically tests technical, performance, SEO, accessibility, and UX problems, generating AI fix prompts and verifying fixes.

posts.name: FFmpeGo
posts.tagline: FFmpeg in the cloud, billed by compute seconds
posts.description: Cheap, serverless FFmpeg encoding in the cloud. Pay only for successful encodes, metered by compute seconds — with hard monthly caps.

posts.name: Thawdrop
posts.tagline: Share files & folders peer-to-peer. No upload, no size limit
posts.description: Thawdrop shares files and folders straight from your computer with a link or QR code. Nothing is uploaded and nothing sits on a server, so there's no size limit. The receiver only needs a browser: they see the file list and download just the files they pick. Add a password (encrypted before sharing), an expiry time or a download limit. Desktop app for macOS and Windows. Open source under MIT.

posts.name: BeSorted
posts.tagline: Most reminders stop when they remind you. We get it sorted.
posts.description: BeSorted is a consumer life-admin resolution app that moves everyday matters from "needs sorting" to genuinely Sorted. Whether it's an MOT, home insurance, vet or dentist appointment, BeSorted prepares everything a user needs to act: 1-tap calls, pre-composed emails, WhatsApp messages, and documents — while keeping them in full control. Trusted Sharing feature allows the user to collaborate on specific upcoming matters with a partner or family member without sharing their entire account.

posts.name: ShellCanvas
posts.tagline: Your SSH servers, together in a desktop workspace
posts.description: A free, open-source workspace for SSH servers: browse files, transfer data, open terminals and edit text in movable windows. Nothing to install on the server. Built with Rust, Tauri and React, with apps and themes from GitHub. Early preview for Windows, Linux and macOS; Windows has had the most hands-on testing.

posts.name: Waivly - Grow Your Network Authentically
posts.tagline: Build relationships, don't just collect contacts
posts.description: Connect, learn, and grow in the private global network built for meaningful relationships, new opportunities, and lasting progress.

posts.name: MyCoCreator for YouTube-Chrome Extension
posts.tagline: Vet and price any YouTube creator right on their channel
posts.description: We're launching chrome extension so you can vet YouTube creators right from your tab. Open any YouTube channel to see median views, engagement, past sponsors and rate ranges right on the page, with no tab switching.
